request.description:
Update an owned draft

Submitters can update only their own drafts; intake roles can update drafts they manage. Updating a draft clears its outstanding information request. The tracking reference and submitter ownership remain unchanged.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409

request.description:
Register and forward a draft, or forward a received submission

A draft is registered and forwarded in one transaction. Stores the sector assignment, stage history, and durable submission.forwarded outbox event in the same transaction.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409

exec: pm.test('Status is documented for this endpoint', function () {

request.description:
Advance a forwarded submission through the pipeline

Only FORWARDED to IN_PROGRESS and IN_PROGRESS to COMPLETED are allowed. Backward transitions and skipped stages are rejected.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409

exec: pm.test('Status is documented for this endpoint', function () {

request.description:
Add document metadata to a case

Records document metadata only. fileReference is optional and, when present, must be an opaque [A-Za-z0-9_-] identifier such as the value returned by the upload endpoint; URLs, filesystem paths, and raw file bytes are rejected. Submitters may only set status SUBMITTED and only for their own drafts.

Expected documented status codes: 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409

request.description:
Create a walk-in submission with a minimal submitter account

Reception can capture a walk-in brief and create a minimal SUBMITTER account in one step. If the email already has an account it is reused. When a new account is created, temporaryPassword is returned exactly once and mustChangePassword is set so the submitter changes it at first login. The account and draft are committed together.

Expected documented status codes: 201, 400, 401, 403, 409

request.description:
Read the reception verification checklist

Returns the same four canonical checklist lines for every submission category: DETAILS_COMPLETE, DOCUMENTS_COMPLETE, FILES_READABLE, and CORRECT_TYPE. Lines that have not been saved yet are returned unchecked.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 401, 403, 404

request.description:
Tick reception checklist lines with a note per line

Updates one or more checklist lines. A note can be recorded per line. The checklist can only be changed while the submission is DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or RECEIVED; it becomes read-only once the submission is forwarded.

Expected documented status codes: 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409
